worldcombat.skill.skyattack.summary: Charge in place for a full beat, then soar up and plunge straight down onto the target as a heavy blow; a target that moves during the plunge is missed. A hit may flinch it. High Dive charges longer but hits harder.
The plunge deals %1$s base power (physical); charge altitude is %2$s blocks and descent speed %3$s blocks/tick; the drop point is fixed at take-off.
Charge takes %1$s, the impact radius is %2$s blocks; the charge is spent standing still and can be interrupted - this move's open flaw.
On a hit there is a %1$s chance to flinch the target for %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.highDive.on: High Dive: altitude x1.3, plunge power x1.12 and a longer flinch; costs +6 charge and +12 cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.highDive.off: Low Dive: a faster, safer windup with altitude and power a notch lower.
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.timing: Range %1$s, windup %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.growth.0: From level %1$s the plunge power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.growth.1: From level %1$s the plunge power is %2$s and the flinch chance rises to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.use.0: Charge a beat, then drop a heavy blow from above
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.use.1: Reach a distant target over ground obstacles
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.use.2: Pin an airborne foe to the ground
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.preference.h: On: altitude x1.3, plunge power x1.12 and a longer flinch, but +6 charge and +12 cooldown - a longer opening for a heavier blow. Off (Low Dive): a faster, safer windup with altitude and power a notch lower.
worldcombat.skill.skyattack.preference.a: It only considers taking off within this distance; smaller keeps it close, larger lets it open from farther away.
When on, an airborne target ranks higher - the drop point sits right on it and it is harder to slip away during the charge; when off all targets rank alike.
